C0914.title: Shenzhen's First 'Medical Insurance Card Cash-Out' Case Sees 11 Sentenced
C0914.summary: In February 2022, Shenzhen's first criminal case targeting intermediaries facilitating medical insurance card cash-outs was adjudicated.
